meta.note: This dataset summarizes existing update pages. It does not reproduce official announcements.

summary.en: Update first, then re-check animal, subway and vehicle symptoms that match the official fix list.
summary.zh: 先更新游戏，再重新检查公告点名的动物、地铁和车辆症状。

changes.en: Several animal disappearance and doorway/loading paths are covered by the hotfix.
changes.zh: 热修覆盖多种动物消失，以及卡在门口或读档后的路径。

changes.en: Roped animals freezing after subway travel and vehicles becoming unresponsive at AutoHue are listed fixes.
changes.zh: 拴绳动物坐地铁后冻结、车辆进入 AutoHue 后失去响应被列入修复。

changes.en: The incubator wording distinguishes an infertile egg from a confirmed hatch failure.
changes.zh: 孵化提示语区分不育鸡蛋与已确认的孵化失败。

title.en: Launch hotfix: offline and co-op checks
title.zh: 发售热修：离线与联机排查

summary.en: Keep the launch fix as historical context; compare the title-screen build before reusing its troubleshooting steps.
summary.zh: 保留发售热修作为历史背景；复用旧排查步骤前先比较标题画面的版本。

changes.en: The launch update addressed a Steam Offline Mode loading case.
changes.zh: 发售更新处理了 Steam 离线模式下的一类加载问题。

changes.en: The launch update addressed a friend-session join case, while online co-op still needs Steam sign-in and internet access.
changes.zh: 发售更新处理了一类好友联机加入问题，但在线联机仍需要登录 Steam 和网络。

title.en: Transport update: parking, subway and recovery
title.zh: 交通更新：停车、地铁与车辆找回

summary.en: Use the current transport sequence to separate approved parking, subway travel and missing-vehicle symptoms.
summary.zh: 按当前交通流程区分合规停车、地铁出行和车辆消失症状。

changes.en: The current transport notes connect approved parking, subway travel and the My Garage recovery path.
changes.zh: 当前交通整理将合规停车、地铁出行和 My Garage 找回流程连在一起。

changes.en: The 0.8.10.562 hotfix narrows the known roped-animal subway symptom; it does not prove every missing vehicle has the same cause.
changes.zh: 0.8.10.562 热修缩小了拴绳动物地铁症状的范围，但不能证明所有车辆消失都有同一原因。
